requirements.title: Actual arguments for CONTIGUOUS dummy pointers must be simply contiguous
requirements.definition: The actual argument corresponding to a dummy pointer with the CONTIGUOUS attribute is required to be simply contiguous.

pending.contiguous-dummy-pointer-noncontiguous-a: PENDING diagnostic/control pair: the rejected program has the same names, dummy interface, section form, and observable first-element result as the positive control, changing only the actual section stride from CALL s(a(::1)) to CALL s(a(::2)); a(::2) is not simply contiguous for the CONTIGUOUS dummy pointer. A required diagnostic is expected, with no assertion on diagnostic wording.
